sentence: Driven by an underlying sense of weakness and insecurity, Kali Carbonicum is engaged in a continuous effort to maintain structure and order, oscillating between rigid control, anxiety about survival, and physical collapse.
references: Herscu, P. ND, DHANP. 'The Cycle of Kali Carbonicum.' New England Journal of Homeopathy, Vol 5 #2.
Herscu, P. & Rothenberg, A. NESH curriculum materials.

segments.name: Weakness and insecurity
segments.description: Fundamental sense of being unable to sustain oneself. Weakness, especially in back and legs. Feels everything gives way. Need for support.

segments.name: Desire for order and structure
segments.description: Compulsive need for routine, predictability, everything in its place. Fastidious, methodical, rigid. Anxiety if order is disrupted. Must plan ahead.

segments.name: Fear of poverty and ruin
segments.description: Anxiety about financial security, about being unable to provide. Fear of loss, of becoming destitute. Worries about business, about the future.

segments.name: Irritability and anger at disorder
segments.description: When structure is threatened, becomes irritable, angry, domineering. Dictatorial, quarrelsome. Everything and everyone is wrong. Critical.

segments.name: Physical collapse and edema
segments.description: The rigid control breaks down into physical pathology: edema, dropsy, ascites. Swelling, fluid retention. Heart and kidney weakness. Must lie flat. Worse cold, worse motion.

segments.name: Desire for warmth and support
segments.description: In the collapsed state, desperate need for warmth, company, reassurance. Wants to be covered, cannot tolerate cold. Clings to loved ones. Anxiety worse alone, worse at night.
